batch: Revamp S2 Customer Work: Wave 2 phase 1, the work-item adapter
kind: Read-only adapter and its tests, built to docs/revamp/specs/work-items.md. No screen yet (phase 2).
findingsNote: No gap is created or changed. No route, table, migration, switch or write is added.
status: Built on branch revamp/customer over main 4b7f83e. CI on the exact pushed head is the verifier; see the pull request for its result.
newFilesOnly: tests/integration/revamp-work-items.test.ts (vitest, no browser, no database, 30 tests: W-01 to W-15, request titles and the detail cap)

decisions.participationOmitted: Decided by the Conductor, 4 Nov 2026 (spec case W-15): customerParticipants.own() rows carry no workspaceId, so a registration is never a work item and is never read. The Delegation registrations link stays on the Work view.
decisions.requestTitle: A request title is requestTitle(detail.original), as the requests route derives it; null when the detail was not read.
decisions.dates: Items carry `at` and `atKind`. Drafts and service requests are 'updated'; requests and programmes are 'created'. Ordering is by `at`.
decisions.programmesHaveNoStatus: A programme has no status of its own, so its item status is empty.
decisions.detailCap: Guardian finding 1 (medium): at most 30 request details are read (workDetailCap), newest request first, and the list is marked partial when more exist. Requests beyond the cap are listed unclassified and untitled.

receipts.red: Before the code: 23 of 23 failed (module not found). After the Guardian and Conductor amendments, tests were changed first and 5 failed before the code.
receipts.green: After the code: 30 passed of 30 (local, node 22).
receipts.mutations: Removing the workspace filter fails W-06; listing non-OPEN drafts fails W-08; classifying an objective in more than one family fails W-02 and W-03; reading details in id order instead of newest first fails the 31-request case; dropping the partial flag fails it too. Each restored.
receipts.checks: pnpm format:check, pnpm lint and pnpm typecheck: exit 0 each (node scripts/gate.mjs receipts in work/).

notRun: Full integration, operator and Playwright suites (CI runs them on the pushed head).
No rendered screen exists in this PR; widths, axe and states H-01 to H-08 belong to phase 2.
sensitive: Tenant scope: items are kept only for workspaces from customerWorkspaces.list; Guardian review requested.
